This is insurance fraud. In Chinese criminal law, this is "诈骗" (fraud) specifically "保险诈骗" maybe "诈骗罪". Also possibly "伪造交通事故" could be "伪造证据罪"? But typical is "诈骗罪" (fraud) using false claims to insurance. So answer: 诈骗. In examples, they sometimes list multiple crimes separated by semicolon. Here only one: 诈骗. So format: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>.
